== English errata comparison sources ==
Decipher replaces Emperor Palpatine with Emperor in the deploy clause. The 2013 Players Committee strip repeats that wording but its header says Effect. The original and later full faces, and the game text of the strip itself, identify an Utinni Effect. The June 2017 slip specifies loss from Life Force equal to half their Life Force. Rounding, targets, and release survive.

Players Committee, [[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=9|Decipher Errata]], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 9. Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=130|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 130. [[:File:CC-D-theemperorsprize.gif|Complete replacement face]]. Earlier documentary state: Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary Supplement.pdf#page=7|Glossary Supplement]], updated 29 January 2002, PDF page 7. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 9. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]. The distinct state has a publication identifier and empty playable and face fields.
